tagrun.title: TagRun
tagrun.summary: TagRun is an RFID-based system that allows freerunners to measure and compare their speed across different sections of a parcours.

xr-posture-checker.title: XR Posture Checker
xr-posture-checker.summary: Using a Meta Quest 3 and depth cameras, XR Posture Checker analyzes workplace ergonomics in XR without requiring the physical workspace to be built first.

puzzle-roulette.title: Puzzle Roulette
puzzle-roulette.summary: A physical escape-room game inspired by 'Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes', where players work together to solve puzzles under time pressure.

kitchenapp.title: KitchenApp
kitchenapp.summary: A home inventory management system that makes it easy to keep track of ingredients, quantities, and nutritional information.

post-it-machine.title: Post-It Machine
post-it-machine.summary: An old receipt printer transformed into an automated Post-It machine for printing short notes and shopping lists.

foh.intro: The mixing desk. Put music on the stage speakers and run the lights.
foh.tip: Pick one or more colours: the show alternates them. Then walk to a booth: the music keeps coming from the stage speakers. Headphones make it easiest to hear where they are.
foh.desks: Click the screens: the audio desk for music, the lighting desk on the right for the lights.
